# PDF.js 6.4.299

Unmodified legacy distribution assets from Mozilla PDF.js, Apache-2.0.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/download/v6.4.299/pdfjs-6.4.299-legacy-dist.zip

Archive SHA-256: `c894bce53b2f4c3e13141e088c89cc051a1f7118ba4a2c02ec058798ae1303d1`

Included: `pdf.mjs`, `pdf.worker.mjs`, CMaps, standard fonts, WASM decoders,
and their licenses. The generic viewer, scripting sandbox and source maps
are not used. Deploy this directory together with the other static assets.
